description.es: Servidor multimedia Jellyfin (puerto 8096) con TLS, WebSocket (SyncPlay y el control remoto) y comprobación de /health. En Jellyfin, añade la IP de HAProxy a «Proxies conocidos» en Redes.
description.en: Jellyfin media server (port 8096) with TLS, WebSocket (SyncPlay and remote control) and a /health check. In Jellyfin, add HAProxy's IP to “Known proxies” under Networking.

lines: http-check send meth GET uri /health ver HTTP/1.1 hdr Host {{domain}}
